title: Unified Nilpotent Operational Framework: Foundations, Algebraic Exactness, and Complexity
summary: A unified algebraic framework is developed to study nilpotency as a structural mechanism for exactness in operational, combinatorial, and computational problems. The central object is the Nilpotent Operational System (SON), formalized as a tuple (R, N, m, M_R), where R is a C-algebra, N satisfies N^{m+1}=0, and M_R(m) is the arithmetic cost of a product in R. The basic result is the Exact Termination Lemma: every formal series evaluated at N collapses to an exact finite sum of m+1 terms.
